verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own self-hosting docs explicitly promise "Full control over data location": it runs on any Docker-capable host, with one-click marketplace installs. Data can also move between Appwrite Cloud and a self-hosted instance via one-click migrations, so users can place data wherever they deploy it. Missing for 10: any evidence of a region or residency picker on Appwrite Cloud (residency is only achievable by running your own infrastructure), documented per-region guarantees or residency compliance terms, and independent hands-on confirmation of residency control.
